description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for formatting and printing expectation-related messages in testing, including diff display, message formatting, and color utilities, specific to the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: serializeExpectedTextValues
methods.description: Serializes an array of strings or RegExp objects into ExpectedTextValue objects with options for matching substring, whitespace normalization, and case ignoring.

methods.name: formatMatcherMessage
methods.description: Formats a detailed message for test matcher failures, including expected and received values, diffs, timeouts, and logs.

methods.name: callLogText
methods.description: Generates a formatted string of call logs with color highlighting.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedSubstring
methods.description: Highlights a substring within a received string that is expected to contain a certain substring, with color formatting.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedResult
methods.description: Formats the result of a string containment check, highlighting the matching substring if present.
